ns2:course.label: Adult & Professional Education
ns2:course.description: This course takes a broad look at the philosophy, theory, research, and practice of adult education, along with additional consider4ations for the development of professionals. The broad perspective includes the social, cultural, and political factors that affect the research, planning, development, and implementation of adult education. You may explore the major adult learning theories, the practice of adult education, and the aims and challenges of professional education that match you scholarly and practical interests.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is for Doctoral and advanced Master's level students.
